statement: Israeli President Isaac Herzog formally tasks Gadi Eisenkot with forming the next government between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: TRUE if the Office of the President of Israel, or at least two of Reuters, AP and Times of Israel, report the mandate conferred on Eisenkot between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-13; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: The mandate is not conferred on Eisenkot by the end of 2026-11-13, either because another lawmaker receives it or because no assignment is made in the window.

statement: Russell Brand receives a total custodial sentence of 10 years or more at a sentencing hearing held between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: TRUE if the total custodial term imposed by the trial court between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-20 is 10 years or more, per the judiciary sentencing remarks or BBC and PA Media court reports; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: The total custodial term imposed is under 10 years, or no sentence is passed between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-20.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog carries a Zyxel entry with a date-added value between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog JSON contains at least one entry with vendorProject Zyxel and dateAdded between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04 inclusive; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No KEV entry with vendorProject Zyxel has a dateAdded value between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04.

statement: The Federal Open Market Committee raises the federal funds target range at its scheduled meeting concluding 2026-12-09.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DFEDTARU, the target range upper limit, is higher for 2026-12-10 than for 2026-12-09; FALSE if equal or lower.
failure_condition: The target range upper limit in effect on 2026-12-10 is equal to or lower than the limit in effect on 2026-12-09.

statement: Mississippi certifies Democrat Scott Colom as winner of the 2026 US Senate election over Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith, with statewide certification issued between 2026-11-06 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: TRUE if certified statewide results issued by the Mississippi Secretary of State between 2026-11-06 and 2026-12-11 show Colom with the most votes; FALSE if Hyde-Smith leads or no statewide certification is issued in that window.
failure_condition: Certified statewide results show Hyde-Smith with the most votes, or no statewide certification is issued between 2026-11-06 and 2026-12-11.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant maturity yield is at or above 5.00 percent on 2026-12-11. Reference: 4.84 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DGS10 for 2026-12-11 is 5.00 or higher; FALSE if lower. Reference: 4.84 percent at seal on 2026-11-05.
failure_condition: The DGS10 value for 2026-12-11 is below 5.00 percent.

statement: The Bank of England Monetary Policy Committee raises Bank Rate at its scheduled decision announced on 2026-12-17.
resolution: TRUE if the Bank of England Official Bank Rate series IUDBEDR is higher for 2026-12-18 than for 2026-12-16; FALSE if equal or lower.
failure_condition: Bank Rate in effect on 2026-12-18 is equal to or lower than the rate in effect on 2026-12-16.

statement: The United States and Iran both publicly confirm an interim or final agreement that provides for reopening the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping, between 2026-11-06 and 2026-12-18.
resolution: TRUE if, between 2026-11-06 and 2026-12-18, both governments confirm such an agreement, as reported by at least two of Reuters, AP and AFP; FALSE if either government has not confirmed one in that window.
failure_condition: By the end of 2026-12-18 Washington and Tehran have not both confirmed an agreement providing for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

statement: A government headed by Gadi Eisenkot as prime minister wins a Knesset confidence vote and is sworn in between 2026-11-06 and 2027-01-08.
resolution: TRUE if the Knesset website, or at least two of Reuters, AP and Times of Israel, record Eisenkot sworn in as prime minister between 2026-11-06 and 2027-01-08; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Eisenkot is not sworn in as prime minister between 2026-11-06 and 2027-01-08.

statement: At least one chamber of the US Congress passes a joint resolution or bill directing the removal of US armed forces from hostilities against Iran between 2027-01-03 and 2027-03-31.
resolution: TRUE if Congress.gov records House or Senate passage, between 2027-01-03 and 2027-03-31, of a joint resolution or bill directing removal of US armed forces from hostilities against Iran; concurrent resolutions do not count. Otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Neither the House nor the Senate passes such a joint resolution or bill between 2027-01-03 and 2027-03-31.
